full_judgment:
ATM Afzal CJ: Plaintiff-petitioners instituted Title suit No. 76 of 1994 in the Second Court of Subordinate Judge, Sylhet for declaration of title to and recovery of Khas possession of the suit land and prayed for an order of temporary injunction restraining the defendants from making any construction on the suit plot pending disposal of the suit. The prayer was allowed by order dated 8-1-95. 

 Plaintiffs purchased plot No. 3775 with an area of 0.50 acre. To the west lies a tank bearing plot No. 3773 0.18 acre out of the land purchased by the plaintiff went into tank and was wrongly recorded as part of suit plot No. 3773. Plaintiffs in this suit prayed for recovery of Khas possession of that land measuring 0.18 acre.
